title: Atomic functional site scaffolding in biopolymers with RFdiffusion3
title_zh: RFdiffusion3在生物聚合物中的原子功能位点支架
abstract: The catalytic and other sophisticated functions of biomolecules arise from the placement of many atoms in three-dimensional space. Here, we describe a generative artificial intelligence method for biopolymers, RFdiffusion3 (RFD3), which employs free atom diffusion to satisfy complex sets of atomic constraints more rapidly and accurately than previous methods across several challenges from enzyme design to RNA structure design. We demonstrate experimentally the power of the RFD3 pipeline for enzyme design by designing de novo phosphotriesterases with a complex active site architecture incorporating a carbamylated lysine coordinating two metal ions and zinc proteases specific for the transthyretin protein involved in amyloid diseases; in both cases we obtain active catalysts in zero shot 96 construct design campaigns.
abstract_zh: 生物分子的催化和其他复杂功能源于大量原子在三维空间中的排列。本文介绍了一种用于生物聚合物的生成式人工智能方法——RFdiffusion3（RFD3），该方法利用自由原子扩散技术，比以往方法更快、更准确地满足复杂的原子约束，已在从酶设计到RNA结构设计等多项挑战中得到验证。我们通过实验展示了RFD3在酶设计中的强大能力，设计了具有复杂活性位点结构的全新磷三酯酶，该活性位点包含羧化赖氨酸，协调两个金属离子，并针对与淀粉样疾病相关的转甲状腺蛋白的锌蛋白酶；在这两种情况下，我们在零样本的96个构建设计项目中均获得了活性催化剂。
